metadata.name: carts
metadata.notes:
1. Get the application URL by running these commands:
  export POD_NAME=$(kubectl get pods --namespace carts -l "app.kubernetes.io/name=carts,app.kubernetes.io/instance=carts" -o jsonpath="{.items[0].metadata.name}")
  echo "Visit http://127.0.0.1:8080 to use your application"
  kubectl --namespace carts port-forward $POD_NAME 8080:80

attributes.name: carts
values:
image:
  repository: public.ecr.aws/aws-containers/retail-store-sample-cart
  tag: 1.6.1

serviceAccount:
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::099875620094:role/retail-store-carts-dynamo



app:
  persistence:
    provider: dynamodb
    dynamodb:
      tableName: retail-store-carts

metadata.name: checkout
metadata.notes:
1. Get the application URL by running these commands:
  export POD_NAME=$(kubectl get pods --namespace checkout -l "app.kubernetes.io/name=checkout,app.kubernetes.io/instance=checkout" -o jsonpath="{.items[0].metadata.name}")
  echo "Visit http://127.0.0.1:8080 to use your application"
  kubectl --namespace checkout port-forward $POD_NAME 8080:80
